description: The share of PRIM calls of this Paris hour is gone (or the daily cap is reached), and the server holds no answer of the stop younger than 5 minutes. It tries again at the start of the next Paris hour that has calls left (the next Paris day once the daily cap is reached). retryAt is the time; Retry-After gives the same time in seconds from the answer. The request is at 2026-10-02T08:30:00Z (10:30 in Paris), so the server tries again from 09:00:00Z (11:00 in Paris). retryAt adds 0 to 59 seconds that depend on the stop and on that hour (40 s for this stop at 11:00), so that the apps of different stops do not all ask at the same second, and the same stops do not ask last every hour; every rider of one stop gets the same time.
